title: Moroccan Cumin Carrot Salad with Orange and Mint
summary: A bright Moroccan-style salad of tender carrots, sweet orange, fresh mint and warm cumin. It’s light, refreshing and ideal for a vegan lunch or as part of a mezze spread.
steps: Bring a saucepan of water to the boil. Add the carrots and cook for 4 to 6 minutes, until just tender but still slightly crisp. Drain well and cool for a few minutes.
While the carrots cook, zest one orange if you like a stronger citrus flavour, then peel both oranges and cut the segments into bite-sized pieces, catching any juice.
In a large bowl, whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice, cumin, ground coriander, salt and black pepper.
Add the warm carrots to the dressing and toss well so they absorb the spices and citrus.
Fold in the orange pieces and most of the mint. Taste and adjust with a little more salt or lemon juice if needed.
Transfer to a serving dish and finish with the remaining mint. Serve warm or at room temperature.
